Actual-future selection of failed candidate0 identifies local Value/continuation-outcome mismatch; it does not erase the known failure or prove predictions have no causal effect.

Forecast feature error is relative to encoded real consequences, not pixel MSE, raw physical state error or task utility.
No significance, population ASR or independent generalization from a single post-hoc root. Preserve existing first-choice support bounds and failed extension gate.
